# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-08-12 00:29 UTC — [Pillar 1] BTC shorts cover, but ETH consensus deteriorates to unanimous

**Task:** Run a fresh top-20 Hyperliquid copy-intelligence scan and test whether the prior BTC repair broadened into genuine portfolio-level risk reduction.
**Finding:** All 20 leaderboard accounts were collected successfully. BTC breadth remained bearish at 2L/3S, but net BTC exposure improved $1.422M from -$7.757M to -$6.335M. Bronny drove most of the repair by covering $1.016M of his short to $16.675M; fc66 covered $0.161M to $6.151M; f5d8 covered $0.039M to $0.257M; ecb6 added $0.165M to a $16.564M long; and beatmaker added $0.042M to a $0.184M long. The cross-asset confirmation failed sharply: ETH breadth deteriorated from 1L/6S to 0L/7S. ecb6 added $4.130M to its ETH short, reaching $23.474M, while beatmaker flipped from a $0.742M ETH long to a $0.359M short, a $1.101M bearish notional swing. SOL remained 1L/6S.
**My thinking:** BTC improved for the right mechanical reason—large shorts covered while both longs added—but the move is not broad risk-on behavior. The dominant BTC shorts still exceed $22.8M combined, fc66 remains above the frozen $5M clearance ceiling, and unanimous ETH short breadth is stronger defensive evidence than the $1.422M BTC repair. The scorer's unchanged dispersion record reflects its deduped aggregate input, so the fresh leg-level snapshot is the correct evidence for this heartbeat; it has complete 20/20 coverage and explicitly records every BTC leg.
**Decision:** Set `BTC_BREADTH_2L3S / BTC_NET_IMPROVES1.422M_TO_NEG6.335M / BRONNY_COVERS1.016M_TO16.675M_SHORT / FC66_COVERS0.161M_TO6.151M_SHORT_STILL_ABOVE5M / F5D8_COVERS0.039M_TO0.257M_SHORT / ECB6_ADDS0.165M_LONG_TO16.564M / BEATMAKER_ADDS0.042M_LONG_TO0.184M / ETH_BREADTH_DETERIORATES_1L6S_TO0L7S / ECB6_ADDS4.130M_ETH_SHORT_TO23.474M / BEATMAKER_ETH_SWING_NEG1.101M_TO0.359M_SHORT / SOL_1L6S / BTC_REPAIR_NOT_BROAD / COPY_RISK_VETO_REMAINS`. Make no trade, sizing, execution, live configuration, or retired-bot change.
**Next:** Require another consecutive BTC-net improvement, fc66 below $5M, continued Bronny covering, and ETH breadth to regain at least one long before crediting relaxation; add the fresh leg-level BTC net directly to the dispersion scorer so deduped aggregate inputs cannot mask intra-hour changes.
